items.question: Is DeLisha Milton-Jones a coach?
items.answer: Yes. DeLisha Milton-Jones is the head coach at Old Dominion, which hired her on April 17, 2020; 2026-27 is her seventh season in Norfolk. She was previously head coach at Pepperdine and an assistant at Syracuse.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did DeLisha Milton-Jones play for?
items.answer: DeLisha Milton-Jones played for the Los Angeles Sparks (1999 to 2004 and 2008 to 2012), the Washington Mystics (2005 to 2007), San Antonio (2013), the New York Liberty (2013 and 2014) and the Atlanta Dream (2014 and 2015). She won WNBA titles with the Sparks in 2001 and 2002.

items.question: Did the Sparks retire DeLisha Milton-Jones's jersey?
items.answer: Yes. The Los Angeles Sparks retired her No. 8 jersey in a halftime ceremony on July 28, 2026.

items.question: What were DeLisha Milton-Jones's career averages?
items.answer: DeLisha Milton-Jones averaged 11.2 points and 5.2 rebounds in 499 WNBA regular-season games from 1999 to 2015.

items.question: How tall is DeLisha Milton-Jones?
items.answer: DeLisha Milton-Jones is listed at 6 feet 1 inch. She played forward.
